title: DS41RT v10 / TP3 report manifest
description: Binds every rendered v10 TP3 table to raw bench output and the exact artifact identity it was measured on. Covers both three-rank arms: the explicit native TP3xEP1 arm and the implicit compact EXL3 TP3 arm. A renderer must never invent a value: any arm/family/field that is absent or null renders as an em dash or an explicit PENDING cell.

report_title.description: Optional H1 title for the rendered report.

report_status.description: Optional status banner, e.g. 'NOT EXECUTED - pending raw manifests'. Not a substitute for the per-family accounting table.

report_class.description: Publication class. 'informational' means the report is published for information and is not a formal release qualification.

harness_provenance.description: Measured-time harness/corpus digests and any post-run harness corrections, so raw records are attributed to the file that produced them.

images.description: Optional at campaign start: the v10 pair is not published yet, and a manifest must be able to describe an unmeasured campaign. When present, both roles are required.

spark_link_mbps.description: Negotiated per-rail link speed observed live, not advertised.

evidence.description: Path to the captured link/route evidence.

basis.description: Where the thresholds come from (observed historical repeat spread).

family.description: EXL3 family tag, e.g. k34. Null for the official checkpoint.

bits.description: Declared bit family for a mixed-projection EXL3 checkpoint, e.g. [3, 4].

exl3_family_manifest.description: In-image EXL3 family manifest path required by the compact arm (run.sh refuses a launch whose selected family manifest is absent).

accounting.description: Protocol values the expected record counts are derived from. The renderer re-derives the per-family expectations from the live harness scripts and this protocol, so the expectation is reproducible and never a hand-asserted total.

repeats.description: Timed samples per cell (protocol: warmup + three matched runs).

topology.description: TP3xEP1 for the explicit native arm; TP3 for the implicit compact EXL3 TP3 layout.

topology_form.description: The native arm names SPARK_TP=3/SPARK_EP=1; the compact EXL3 arm is implicit SPARK_COUNT=3 with no TP/EP keys.

config_path.description: Path to the captured launch config.

resident_bytes_per_rank.description: Routed weight bytes resident per Spark rank for this arm.

remote_layers.description: Layers the coordinator dispatches to the Sparks.

worker_allocated_layers.description: Layers the worker actually allocated/loaded; may exceed the dispatched count.

ceiling.description: Memory-reservation ceiling fields. Required for the compact EXL3 arm's 32 GiB simulation; the native arm may carry null.

memory_reservation_bytes.description: Ceiling in bytes, as resolved at launch.

evidence.description: Captured log/reservation line proving the resolved ceiling.

runtime_flags.description: Actual resolved launch flags/geometry recorded from argv+log, not the intended config.

evidence_package.description: Directory that this arm's relative raw paths resolve against (the lane directory that holds the evidence).

measurement_provenance.description: The measured config identity and the current published profile, so a reader can see when the numbers predate a profile change.

limitations.description: Caveats that qualify the measured numbers. Reported alongside the values, never used to change them.

bootstrap_only.description: True for a pre-measurement placeholder manifest. A bootstrap-only manifest carries no measured value and must never replace one that does.

failures.description: Retained negative results; a failure is reported, never silently dropped.

harness_provenance.description: Harness/corpus digests captured with the measurement plus any post-run source corrections.

digests.description: Repo-relative source path -> SHA-256 as measured.

correction.description: A harness change made after the run, recorded so raw records are not retroactively attributed to the newer file.

measurement_provenance.description: The config identity actually measured versus the current published profile.

pin_commit.description: Commit that introduced the KV_POOL_SIZE pin, when the current profile commit only carries later edits.

limitation.description: A caveat attached to a measured arm. It qualifies the values and never changes them.

raw.description: Raw bench outputs per measured family. A path may be relative to --package or absolute/~-prefixed. Absent/null => an explicit PENDING cell in the report, never a number.

paths.description: One raw path, a list of raw paths, or null.

tool_eval.description: Tool-call evaluation evidence. `summaries` is the qualify-ds41-tool-eval.py summaries.json (one entry per run, each carrying its own per-run score and its failures list). `dir`/`runs` name the per-run directories so non-pass scenario detail can be read from the raw run artifacts.
